title: US Math Scores Fell To 270 After Decades Of Gains
hook: US math scores fell to 270 after decades of gains.
closing: The national average slipped, but the lowest performers absorbed the deepest damage.
question: What would it take to restore the lost math progress?

segments.say: The national math score reached 271, nearly erasing decades of earlier gains.
The lowest-performing students lost 14 points, making an unequal setback even wider.
The score fell to 270, showing the expected recovery still has not arrived.
